title: BLACKBERRY CUSTARD MONSTER 100ML
description:
Check out Blackberry by Custard Monster, which is an incredibly creamy, smooth custard flavor topped off with blackberries bursting with flavor.
Custard Monster is a premium e-liquid that comes in a 100ml chubby gorilla bottle. Its 75% vegetable glycerin (VG) and 25% propylene glycol (PG) base is great for those who desire the best flavor.
Enjoy the creamy vanilla custard laced with succulent, ripe blackberries for a dessert flavor you’ll find hard to resist! With the immediate wave of cream and hints of blackberries the exhale leaves behind the lingering taste of the two, encouraging your taste buds to revisit it over and over again.
Blackberry Custard Monster 100mL Features:
100mL Chubby Unicorn Bottle
Child Resistant Cap
75% VG
25% PG
Made in USA
Available nicotine: 0mg, 3mg, 6mg
